questions.cardText:
[Computer Science] What are the basic binary digits 0 and 1 also known as?
A. Bytes B. Bits C. Bauds
Answer: B. The term “bit” is a contraction of “binary digit,” which is the most basic unit of data in computing and digital communications.
questions.de: Wie heißt eine einzelne Binärziffer, 0 oder 1, die grundlegendste Informationseinheit in der Informatik?
questions.en: What is a single binary digit, 0 or 1, the most basic unit of information in computing, called?

timeline.labelEn: John W. Tukey contracts “binary digit” to “bit” in a Bell Labs memo
timeline.labelDe: John W. Tukey verkürzt in einem Memo der Bell Labs „binary digit“ zu „bit“

questions.cardText:
[History] Who was the second President of the United States?
A. John Adams
B. Benjamin Franklin
C. Thomas Jefferson
Answer: A. John Adams was not only the second President of the United States but also the first Vice President, serving under George Washington. Additionally, Adams and his son, John Quincy Adams, were the first father and son to both serve as Presidents of the United States.
questions.de: Wer war der zweite Präsident der Vereinigten Staaten?
questions.en: Who was the second President of the United States?

timeline.labelEn: John Adams serves as the second President of the United States
timeline.labelDe: John Adams amtiert als zweiter Präsident der Vereinigten Staaten

questions.notes: Only the options removed; the question was already open.
